record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, jointly reduce maximum history length from 64 to 48 and learning rate from 6e-4 to 5.5e-4. Most observed histories fit within 48 positions; shorter tensors reduce convolution cost, while the modestly lower learning rate may stabilize fitting under the changed positional range. Retain width 48, six blocks, kernel 3, dropout 0.10, batch 128 and Adam. Keep all feature, scoring, readout and loss formulas fixed, seeds unchanged, and limits at 200 epochs and 200 batches per epoch; synchronize predictor shapes.

category_rationales.rationale: Jointly shorten maximum history from 64 to 48 and lower learning rate from 6e-4 to 5.5e-4 across all four category models. Shorter sequences reduce convolution cost while covering most observed histories; the slightly smaller learning rate may stabilize optimization. Existing metadata and predictor construction propagate the new maximum length consistently. All other hyperparameters, model formulas, seeds, routing and training limits remain unchanged.
